decision.observation: Stable wide frame: the dirt path visibly passes under the gate's bottom-left rail (~0.25, 0.70) where the bowl sits on the far side. The goose stands east of the right post. This under-rail gap at the left end is the lowest point of the gate.
decision.hypothesis: Crouching (C) reduces the goose's height, possibly fitting it under the bottom rail at the left-end gap; position at the gap first, then hold C while pressing north.
decision.memory: Crouch key C is distinct from bend (Ctrl). Prior bend-under attempts got only the neck through; crouch may lower the body enough.
